error_categories.description: The trace treats the stem-and-leaf values as if they are grounded from the source stemplot, but in this text-only setting no tool-attributed transcription or textual reproduction of the actual first stemplot is provided. The full dataset listed in step 2 is therefore unsupported, and all later counting/median calculations depend on that ungrounded extraction.

summary: The arithmetic and median selection are internally consistent given the listed numbers, and the trace reaches a clear conclusion of E/119. However, in text-only mode the crucial dataset extraction from the unseen stemplot is unsupported, so the final answer is not justified by the trace text alone.
